# SecureShield Dashboard  
Real-time threat intelligence visualization for enterprise cybersecurity operations, leveraging React, TypeScript, and CyberShield's API ecosystem for dynamic incident tracking and risk prioritization  

## Badges  
[![Security Compliance](https://img.shields.io/badge/secure-compliant-blue)](https://example.com)  
[![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/react-2023-blue)](https://react.dev)  
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/typescript-4.9-orange)](https://typescriptlang.org)  

## Getting Started  
```bash  
npx create-next-app@latest secure-shield-dashboard  
cd secure-shield-dashboard  
yarn add @cybershield/api-client @reduxjs/toolkit tailwindcss  
cp .env.example .env  
```  
Configure API credentials in `.env` and run `yarn dev` for local development. All components are statically typed and require no server-side rendering for core functionality.  

## Tech Stack  
- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript 4.9, Next.js 13 for SSR in analytics panels  
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit with normalized data models for 50k+ incident entries  
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support for 24/7 monitoring  
- **Performance**: Webpack 5 chunk splitting for 30% faster load times  
- **Security**: OWASP ZAP integration for runtime injection detection, Snyk for dependency vuln scanning  

## Architecture / Design  
The dashboard employs a microfrontend architecture with Webpack 5 modules for isolated threat visualization components. Redux Toolkit manages global state for incident timelines, risk scores, and asset graphs. Tailwind's JIT compiler ensures responsive layouts for multi-monitor workstations. All API calls use CyberShield's REST endpoints with OAuth2 token refresh middleware.  

## Usage / Examples  
Navigate to `/incidents` for real-time event streams filtered by severity (critical/urgent). Use the timeline component to drill into specific threat vectors, with automatic data fetching via CyberShield's `/api/v2/incidents` endpoint. The asset graph component renders 3D topology with WebGL for large-scale network visualization.  

## Testing  
Unit tests for React components use Jest + React Testing Library, covering 92% of UI logic. Integration tests verify API call accuracy with mocked CyberShield endpoints. Security testing includes OWASP ZAP scans for XSS/CSRF vulnerabilities and Snyk audits for package dependencies. Accessibility checks ensure WCAG 2.1 compliance for screen reader users.
